d: The Quad is strengthening cooperation across the Indo-Pacific. At a meeting on the sidelines of the G20 summit, foreign ministers from India, the United States, Japan and Australia discuss ways to build secure supply chains and deepen collaboration in artificial intelligence and critical minerals. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio reiterates that the Quad is not directed against any country. The four nations also announce plans for their first joint maritime exercise in 2027.
